name: immune-memory
prompt: Edit this scientific textbook diagram. Preserve its square composition, title "Remembering for next time", two-panel layout, headings "First encounter" and "Later encounter", all bottom captions, pale blue panels, white background, teal bacteria, orange Y antibodies, and overall type and style. Correct ONLY the first-encounter upper-left white cell: replace the multi-lobed phagocyte engulfing a bacterium with a ROUND LYMPHOCYTE with one single round purple nucleus. No engulfing membrane or projections around bacteria. The round lymphocyte is beside two teal bacteria. Keep the lower-left round memory lymphocyte and arrow. This avoids teaching that a phagocyte becomes a memory cell: both left-side cells should clearly be round lymphocytes. Keep right-side response illustrations unchanged. No new text or labels.

name: immune-organs
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Recreate Body School textbook illustration "Organs that support the defense". PORTRAIT 4:5 on pure white, softly shaded textbook art, large bold navy sans-serif title and labels in pale blue panels. Show human front view ONLY FROM WAIST UP, complete head, chest, abdomen, upper arms; no hips, groin, pelvis, legs, or lower body anywhere in image. Neutral friendly child figure, anatomical overlay on torso: small bilobed thymus in upper chest below neck behind sternum; green lymph nodes in neck and armpits along fine green lymph vessels; purple spleen on PERSON’S LEFT upper abdomen (VIEWER RIGHT), beneath left ribs. Subtle gray ribs for orientation, no unrelated organs. Four precise labels "Thymus", "Lymph nodes", "Spleen", "Bone marrow". Use viewer-left UPPER ARM HUMERUS: clean explanatory small cutaway at proximal humerus, with a nearby circular enlargement connected directly to that arm showing red marrow INSIDE spongy bone. Bone marrow leader points to RED tissue INSIDE bone inset. Do NOT use thigh bone, hip bone, or femur. Crop ends at WAIST, well above hips. Each leader on correct structure; no crossing lines. Bottom note "Locations simplified". No genitals or lower torso, no gore or injury, no watermark. All labels large and fully inside frame.
